questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^5.
hints: Apply the power rule: bring the power down as a coefficient.

questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^{-3}.
hints: Use the power rule with a negative exponent.
Remember to reduce the power by 1.
The derivative of sine is cosine.
The derivative of cosine is negative sine.

questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = e^x.
hints: The exponential function is its own derivative.

questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = ln x.
hints: The derivative of ln x is 1/x.
Remember the derivative of a constant is 0.
The derivative of tan x is sec^2 x.

questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = 4e^x - 2ln x.
hints: Differentiate each term using the standard rules.

questions.prompt: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^{1/2}.
hints: Apply the power rule with a fractional exponent.
